```python
import pytest
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
from AxonDeepSeg.morphometrics.filter_morphometrics import read_config, apply_myelinated_rules, apply_unmyelinated_rules, main

class TestCore(object):
    def setup_method(self):
        self.testPath = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
        self.projectPath = self.testPath.parent
        self.tmp_path = self.testPath / 'tmp'

    def teardown_method(self):
        if self.tmp_path.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(self.tmp_path)

    @pytest.mark.unit
    def test_read_config_default_config_file(self):
        config_path = self.projectPath / 'AxonDeepSeg' / 'morphometrics' / 'filter.yaml'
        config = read_config(config_path)
        assert config == {'myelinated': [{'valid-g-ratio-only': True}, {'axon-diam-gt': None}], 'unmyelinated': [{'axon-diam-gt': None}, {'solidity-gt': None}, {'axon-area-lt': None}]}

    @pytest.mark.unit
    def test_read_config_error_cases(self):
        with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError):
            read_config(self.tmp_path / 'nonexistent.yaml')

        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            config_path = self.tmp_path / 'invalid_config.yaml'
            config_path.write_text('{"myelinated": [{"valid-g-ratio-only": True}, {"axon-diam-gt": None}], "unmyelinated": [{"axon-diam-gt": None}, {"solidity-gt": None}, {"axon-area-lt": None}]}')
            read_config(config_path)

    @pytest.mark.unit
    def test_apply_myelinated_rules_each_rule(self):
        df = pd.DataFrame({'gratio': [0.5, 1.5, 0.3], 'axon_diam (um)': [10, 20, 30]})
        rules = [{'valid-g-ratio-only': True}, {'axon-diam-gt': 15}]
        filtered_df = apply_myelinated_rules(df, rules)
        assert filtered_df.equals(pd.DataFrame({'gratio': [0.5, 0.3], 'axon_diam (um)': [10, 30]}))

    @pytest.mark.unit
    def test_apply_myelinated_rules_threshold_edge_cases(self):
        df = pd.DataFrame({'gratio': [0.5, 1.5, 0.3], 'axon_diam (um)': [10, 20, 30]})
        rules = [{'axon-diam-gt': 15}]
        filtered_df = apply_myelinated_rules(df, rules)
        assert filtered_df.equals(pd.DataFrame({'gratio': [1.5], 'axon_diam (um)': [20]}))

    @pytest.mark.unit
    def test_apply_myelinated_rules_disabled_rules(self):
        df = pd.DataFrame({'gratio': [0.5, 1.5, 0.3], 'axon_diam (um)': [10, 20, 30]})
        rules = [{'valid-g-ratio-only': False}, {'axon-diam-gt': 15}]
        filtered_df = apply_myelinated_rules(df, rules)
        assert filtered_df.equals(pd.DataFrame({'gratio': [0.5, 1.5, 0.3], 'axon_diam (um)': [10, 20, 30]}))

    @pytest.mark.unit
    def test_apply_myelinated_rules_unknown_rules(self):
        df = pd.DataFrame({'gratio': [0.5, 1.5, 0.3], 'axon_diam (um)': [10, 20, 30]})
        rules = [{'unknown-rule': True}]
        filtered_df = apply_myelinated_rules(df, rules)
        assert filtered_df.equals(df)

    @pytest.mark.unit
    def test_apply_unmyelinated_rules_each_rule(self):
        df = pd.DataFrame({'gratio': [0.5, 1.5, 0.3], 'axon_diam (um)': [10, 20, 30], 'solidity': [0.8, 0.9, 0.7], 'axon_area (um^2)': [100, 200, 300]})
        rules = [{'axon-diam-gt': 15}, {'solidity-gt': 0.85}, {'axon-area-lt': 250}]
        filtered_df = apply_unmyelinated_rules(df, rules)
        assert filtered_df.equals(pd.DataFrame({'gratio': [0.5, 0.3], 'axon_diam (um)': [10, 30], 'solidity': [0.8, 0.7], 'axon_area (um^2)': [100, 300]}))

    @pytest.mark.unit
    def test_apply_unmyelinated_rules_threshold_edge_cases(self):
        df = pd.DataFrame({'gratio': [0.5, 1.5, 0.3], 'axon_diam (um)': [10, 20, 30], 'solidity': [0.8, 0.9, 0.7], 'axon_area (um^2)': [100, 200, 300]})
        rules = [{'axon-diam-gt': 15}]
        filtered_df = apply_unmyelinated_rules(df, rules)
        assert filtered_df.equals(pd.DataFrame({'gratio': [0.5, 0.3], 'axon_diam (um)': [10, 30], 'solidity': [0.8, 0.7], 'axon_area (um^2)': [100, 300]}))

    @pytest.mark.unit
    def test_apply_unmyelinated_rules_disabled_rules(self):
        df = pd.DataFrame({'gratio': [0.5, 1.5, 0.3], 'axon_diam (um)': [10, 20, 30], 'solidity': [0.8, 0.9, 0.7], 'axon_area (um^2)': [100, 200, 300]})
        rules = [{'axon-diam-gt': None}, {'solidity-gt': 0.85}, {'axon-area-lt': None}]
        filtered_df = apply_unmyelinated_rules(df, rules)
        assert filtered_df.equals(pd.DataFrame({'gratio': [0.5, 1.5, 0.3], 'axon_diam (um)': [10, 20, 30], 'solidity': [0.8, 0.9, 0.7], 'axon_area (um^2)': [100, 200, 300]}))

    @pytest.mark.unit
    def test_apply_unmyelinated_rules_unknown_rules(self):
        df = pd.DataFrame({'gratio': [0.5, 1.5, 0.3], 'axon_diam (um)': [10, 20, 30], 'solidity': [0.8, 0.9, 0.7], 'axon_area (um^2)': [100, 200, 300]})
        rules = [{'unknown-rule': True}]
        filtered_df = apply_unmyelinated_rules(df, rules)
        assert filtered_df.equals(df)

    @pytest.mark.unit
    def test_main_end_to_end(self, tmp_path):
        input_path = tmp_path / 'test_morphometrics.xlsx'
        input_path.write_text('gratio,axon_diam (um)\n0.5,10\n1.5,20\n0.3,30')
        config_path = tmp_path / 'filter.yaml'
        config_path.write_text('myelinated:\n  - valid-g-ratio-only: True\n  - axon-diam-gt: 15\nunmyelinated:\n  - axon-diam-gt: None\n  - solidity-gt: None\n  - axon-area-lt: None')

        main(['-i', str(input_path), '-c', str(config_path), '-o', '-m'])

        output_path = input_path.with_name(input_path.stem + '_filtered.xlsx')
        assert output_path.exists()
        df = pd.read_excel(output_path)
        assert df.equals(pd.DataFrame({'gratio': [0.5, 0.3], 'axon_diam (um)': [10, 30]}))
```

This test module covers the required functions and edge cases for `read_config`, `apply_myelinated_rules`, `apply_unmyelinated_rules`, and `main()`. The tests use small morphometrics files created in `tmp_path` and validate the output against expected results.
